outcome: maternal and surgical predictors of SSSI
cohort: 453 very severely obese women (BMI >40kg/m2) with a singleton pregnancy delivered by caesarean section between August 2011 and December 2015
finding: Lower maternal age was predictive of SSSI, with current smoking status and longer wound open times being marginally significant.
mod_finding: SSSI rates did not differ between supra-panniculus transverse and infra-panniculus transverse skin incisions.
